sections.name: Verse 1
lines: [G]Hearts unfold like [D7]flow'rs before Thee, [G]Hail Thee [C]as the [G/D]sun [D7]a[G]bove.
[D]Melt the clouds of [G]sin and [D]sadness, Drive the [B7]dark of [Em]doubt [A7]a[D]way;
[G]Giver of im[C]mortal [Am]gladness, [G/D]Fill us with the [D7]light of [G]day!

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: [G]All Thy works with [D7]joy surround Thee, [G]Earth and [C]heav'n re[G/D]flect [D7]Thy [G]rays,
[G]Chanting bird and [C]flowing [Am]fountain [G/D]Call us to re[D7]joice in [G]Thee.

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: [D]Thou the Father, [G]Christ our [D]Brother, All who [B7]live in [Em]love [A7]are [D]Thine:
[G]Teach us how to [C]love each [Am]other, [G/D]Lift us to the [D7]joy di[G]vine.
